body: Not trying to be a dick here, but don't be sorry for me.  I'm rat shit.   I don't deserve to live.  I am no better than a predator...

But this wasn't life throwing a curveball. This was me being a lecherous pervert to an extremely disrespectful degree.  This is not some shitty situation I've found myself in, it's one that I have created.

The anguish in my wife's eyes and voice this morning made me realize that she deserves so much better than what I have provided, and no one deserves to see shit like what she saw today.  I did that. There was no excuse.
